- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment (sentiment < -0.30) — add 3–5% to forecast to account for risk-on rebound.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3–5 days) — cap forecast at 10% above prior peak.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–4% per day until convergence.
- Lagged overreaction: if sentiment turns positive after 3–5 days, forecast should not exceed 5% above prior 14-day average.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overestimate late-cycle prices — reduce final 5–7 days by 3–6% to reflect tapering.
